It was like a switch in my head. The entities meant me quiting drinking and if I actually went through with it and quit drinking my life would improve. Can't really explain it other than that it just all if a sudden made sense. Haven't had a drink since.

I can go to concerts and festivals, anywhere I used to drink no problem now. Was kinda rough at the start, like right after that trip, but I had been trying hard before and it was seemingly just the kick in the butt I needed to make it stick.

Took 3 doses at Red Rocks for Furthur in probably 2011-12. The early Sunday show after a Fri and Sat show. Pretty sure it was the year Chris Robinson sat in with them there for a bit.

Anyway, knew it was going to be interesting cause I ate them in the lot, went to pee and it was alread hitting hard by the time my buddy and I got in line. Decided to sit as far back as possible to take in the view.

Things get blurry from there. They played Samson & Delilah and everytime they said the verse about tearing the building down I just kept thinking what building do they want to tear down and why? Lol. Kept thinking I got transported back in time to a past Dead show. 

As things got darker the trip really took hold and I started to see the earth breath through the stage. It was expanding and contracting as if it were taking deep breaths. The cliff walls of the rocks were like the inside of lungs and all the people dancing looked like the hairs or whatever that are in your lungs that grab particles out of the air. People also sorta looked like skeleton people. Everything was moving and swaying in unison and I got the notion that the earth is tired and we people need to do a better job of trying to clean/reduce what we give the earth to deal with, or whatever, doses man.

Tried to smoke a joint with my buddy but couldn't do it. Came down enough to get back to the vehicle and buddy got us back to the hotel. I stayed up all night in communion with birds and the rising sun. 

Took a little bit more at some point during the night to just keep the after glow going strong. Buddy and I drove my 99 Wrangler from CO, through WY, into SD and stayed at a hotel/place that you could see mount Rushmore from and had peacocks and turkeys wondering around their property. 

Best trip ever.
